description: Unit tests for functions in the 'gn' build system component, testing assertion handling, 'defined' function, function with block errors, list splitting, string hashing, string joining, string replacing, string splitting, declare_args behavior, and print_stack_trace with templates and nested scopes.

methods.name: Assert
methods.description: Tests for the 'assert' function, including passing, failing, and usage error cases.

methods.name: Defined
methods.description: Tests for the 'defined' function, checking undefined, defined, and accessor scenarios.

methods.name: FunctionsWithBlock
methods.description: Tests that functions expecting no block handle block syntax errors appropriately.

methods.name: SplitList
methods.description: Tests for the 'split_list' function with various input sizes and rounding.

methods.name: StringHash
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_hash' function with correct usage and error detection.

methods.name: StringJoin
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_join' function with various separator and list configurations, including error cases.

methods.name: StringReplace
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_replace' function with multiple replacement scenarios.

methods.name: StringSplit
methods.description: Tests for the 'string_split' function with whitespace and string separator splitting, including error detection.

methods.name: DeclareArgs

methods.name: NotNeeded
